newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo sees positive break from trend Q4.
newsitem.headline: Volvo sees positive break from trend Q4.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Wednesday the operating profits in its vehicles units in the fourth quarter of 1996 showed a positive break from a previous downward trend.

"The operating profit for the vehicles unit showed a break in the trend in the fourth quarter. At the time the operating profit rose to 1.46 billion crowns," Volvo managing director Soren Gyll told a news conference.
In the first three quarters of 1996 the operating profit was 970 million crowns, 1.10 billion crowns and 94 million, in each respectively.

"The operating margin in the fourth quarter improved to 3.4 percent. But we still had a bit to go to reach our goal of an operating margin of between five and seven percent over a business cycle," Gyll said.
For full-year 1996 the operating margin was 2.3 percent.
